title: Reverse of a polynomial
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $T$ an indeterminate and $f(T)=\sum_{k=0}^{d}a_kT^k\in R[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] with $d=\deg f$ [def-weil-polynomial-coefficient] (and $d=0$ for $f=0$). The reverse of $f$ is

$$
\operatorname{rev}(f)(T)=\sum_{k=0}^{d}a_kT^{d-k}\in R[T],
$$

that is, $T^{d}f(1/T)$: the coefficient of $T^{j}$ in $\operatorname{rev}(f)$ is $a_{d-j}$ for $0\le j\le d$ and $0$ for $j>d$.
